game.title: Wizardry: Knight of Diamonds - The Second Scenario (NES, USA)

shots.caption: ASCII logo at power-on
Copyright page: Andrew Greenberg and Sir-Tech 1991, Game Studio, ASCII Entertainment
Title: The Knight of Diamonds, Start game / Select switch
Select switch: maze SOLID/LINE, music ON/OFF, sound ON/OFF, return to title
Castle of Llylgamyn: Tavern, Inn, Boltac's, Temple, Edge of Town; party of six below
Gilgamesh's Tavern: Add, Remove, Inspect, Divvy Gold, Leave; party of six below
Tavern > Add: the roster, six pre-made characters and the playtest party
Inspect: RYZ, level 12 Human Fighter, 3412 G.P., AC 0, Sword of swishes and Sturdy plate equipped
Inspect: DEDDO, level 13 Elf Mage, 482916 E.P., mage spell points 8/7/6/5/4/3/2
Read Spell > Mage: DEDDO's book, Halito to Tiltowait (with Tzalik and Ladalto)
Read Spell > Cleric: EBO's book, Kalki to Loktofeit (levels 1-6)
Adventurer's Inn: Stables (free), Cot 10, Economy 50, Merchant 200, Royal Suite 500 GP/week
Inn: RYZ rests in a cot and makes level 13 - stat changes and 1 hit point
Boltac's: Purchase which? Long sword 25, Anointed flail 150, Buckler 20, Shield 40 G.P.
Boltac's: Long sword bought for 25 G.P. - * Just what you needed *
Boltac's stock further down: Rod of iron 3000 (#), scrolls, Padded leather to Body armor 1500 G.P.
Temple of Cant: who shall we help? Dead 250, P-lyze 100, Ashes 500 G.P. (level 1)
Temple: MURMUR - CHANT - WISH - INVOKE, FIGHTER2 is cured
Edge of Town: Training Grounds, Maze, Restart an OUT party, Leave Game, Castle
Training Grounds: Create, Inspect, Delete, Change Name, Change Class, Leave
Training Grounds > Create: the name keyboard, R typed
Name RYZ entered: Create this character? Yes / No
Choose Race: Human, Elf, Dwarf, Gnome, Hobbit
Choose Alignment: Good, Neutral, Evil
Bonus points: Human base scores 8 8 5 8 8 9 and 7 bonus points to share
Select Class: Human with STR 15, IQ 11, VIT 14 may be Fighter, Mage or Samurai
Leave Game (the save point): * CAUTION * Turn Power switch off while pressing Reset-switch
Edge of Town > Maze: Descending into the Ruins under the Temple of Gnilda
Floor 1 at the entrance stairs (0,0), facing north, party window
Maze view with the party window hidden (Start toggles it)
Camp (B): Inspect, Reorder, Equip, Leave
Maze menu (Select): Quit, Search, Set Timer, Leave
Floor 1 (0,0) after leaving camp: Stairs up --- Take them? (back to the castle)
Floor 1 (14,14): a towering apparition appears - Hear the words of Gnilda
Gnilda: acquire the five and get over seven barriers; the apparition fades
Floor 1 (7,12): There is something at your feet - search finds an item
Floor 1 (17,6): a small old man offers a black key for your red key
Floor 1 (10,0): a sign on the door reads Officers only! - pushed back out
Floor 1 (12,2): Are you ready? The armor you seek lies three steps ahead
Floor 1 (3,17): a dusty statue, golden light on broken bone and rusted armor
Floor 1 (19,10): the Kobold King guards the passage - RYZ's options
Cast what spell? MNZ (Bishop): Cleric spell level 1, 4 left - Kalki to Porfic
Orders for the round in the status column: Fight, Fight, Fight, Parry, Parry, Kalki
EBO tries to stab the Kobold King and hits 2 times for 17
The Kobold King bites at CONDI and hits once for 5
CONDI charges at the Kobold King, hits 5 times for 29 - the Kobold King is dispatched
Victory over the guardian: each survivor gets 476 E.P.
The guardian's prize: CUBI found BADGE (the Gory badge, not yet identified)
Floor 2 room: two groups, 7 Women in Robes and 2 Men at Arms - RYZ's options
Cast what spell? DEDDO picks Tiltowait, Magic spell level 7 (2 left)
A Woman in Robes casts a Melito: RYZ takes 7 damage (the spell hits the whole party)
EBO casts a Badialma: a Woman in Robes is dispatched
DEDDO casts a Tiltowait: one Woman in Robes after another is dispatched
A chest! You may: Inspect, Calfo, Disarm, Open, Leave alone
RYZ inspects the chest: Poison Needle
RYZ opens the chest: Oops! Poison Needle
Loot from the chest: RYZ found ARMOR (unidentified)
Treasure: each survivor gets 33 G.P.
Back in the maze after the fight: RYZ is poisoned (status Poison)
Floor 2 room: 8 Rabid Rats (drawn as a white rabbit)
A Woman in Robes thrusts violently at RYZ and hits once for 3 - RYZ is dispatched
After the round: the dead are moved to the back of the party, status Dead
Whole party killed in battle: six tombstones RYZ, CONDI, EBO, CUBI, DEDDO, MNZ
After the wipe: back in the castle with an empty party
Floor 2 (9,18): Three roads to follow, only one you may take
Floor 2 (14,18): an ugly fat orc - Attack the saucy kobold!
Floor 2: barrier - a locked door, the keyhole rusting terribly
Floor 3: a brick-walled well with a sign beside it
The wishing well: The fee is 5000. Will you pay?
Floor 3: A Wizardress is in the room - What a scoundrel! Get out of here!
Floor 3: The next door is locked, and has four keyholes
Floor 3: a chute drops the party to floor 4 - It's dark!
Floor 4: a wizened sage in a pile of dusty, mysterious books
Floor 4: a familiar figure rises and shouts Mapiro Mahama Diromat
Floor 4: the man appears again - I shall make a master key for you
Floor 5: the entrance of a huge cavern, stalactites, damp air
Floor 5: ... A clear blue fountain. Who will wade?
Floor 5: Rock! - the party walks into solid rock
Floor 6: The apparition reappears and intones: One alone.
Floor 6: the room on fire - What a foolish man! get away.
Floor 6: the most evil voice you've ever heard - Where is the stuff now?
Floor 6: words written in a red liquid - I will leave it to the brave
RYZ wears the five pieces of the regalia: Hrathnir, KOD's helmet, shield, gauntlets and armor
RYZ alone in the regalia passes the floor 6 trials and is sent to Gnilda's temple: the apparition
By obtaining the complete regalia... Behold! The staff of Gnilda!
RYZ traded an Item! - the regalia for the staff of Gnilda
Camp > Inspect: RYZ now carries the STAFF of GNILDA; the regalia is gone
Congratulations! The Staff of Gnilda retrieved: the Mark of Gnilda and the order of Knight of the City
Press [A] to select Knights: the hero picks the others who become Knights of the City
Staff roll after the ending, scrolling past the dragon crest: Game Designer Norihiro Sekizuka
After the credits: RYZ wears the Mark of Gnilda (G) and gained 150000 E.P.; the staff is returned
